title: The New Octanuclear Europium Cluster Eu8(DMF)13(μ4-O)(μ3-OH)12(Se3)(Se4)2(Se5)2 Comprising Oxo, Hydroxo, and Polyselenido Ligands

synthesis.procedure: A red-brown solution of nominally K2Se4 was generated by adding K2Se and Se to 8 mL of DMF and stirring for 24 h. EuCl3 was dissolved in 8 mL of THF with stirring and added to the polyselenide solution. The mixture was stirred for 16 h, filtered through a fine glass frit, and layered with 15 mL of diethyl ether. Bright red rectangular plates were manually isolated after 1 week. The crystals are extremely air- and water-sensitive. The low yield (<10%) is attributed to residual water in EuCl3 (0.17 H2O per EuCl3), giving a maximum theoretical yield of 10.5% based on Eu.
synthesis.time: polyselenide solution stirred 24 h; mixed solution stirred 16 h; crystals isolated after 1 week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution synthesis; filtration through a fine glass frit; layering crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered through a fine glass frit, layered with 15 mL of diethyl ether; bright red rectangular plates isolated manually after 1 week
